overall_assessment: Steiner text comes from PDF course plans and is largely complete (learning outcomes, content, work requirements, assessment all present) with a consistent facts box. Problems are one clear wrong-course mismatch and recurring PDF artefacts (page numbers, hard line wraps, stray page-break blank lines).

findings.description: The offering is M-PEL2.2 (Pedagogikk og elevkunnskap 2, emne 2) but the extracted text is the plan for PEL1.5 (Pedagogikk og elevkunnskap 1, emne 5, FoU-oppgave), a different course. The plan for this course code is therefore not captured at all. Only 1 of 8 sampled courses, but such mismatches are silent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: pdf_split strategy maps course codes to PDF sections/pages by code or position; M-PEL2.2 is mapped to the wrong section (or the split looks up the wrong code pattern, e.g. PEL2.2 falling back to a neighbouring/PEL1.5 section).
findings.suggested_fix: In the pdf_split routine, verify that the 'Emnekode og emnenavn' line in the split text contains the requested code (normalised, e.g. PEL2.2 from M-PEL2.2) and set extracted_text to NA when it does not; then fix the code-to-section mapping for PEL2.x (check whether the PDF actually contains PEL2.2).

findings.description: Bare PDF page numbers (e.g. '10', '11', '12', '9') appear as standalone lines, often in the middle of a bullet list or sentence, and trailing at the end of the text. Non-plan text per the rubric.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: PDF text extraction (pdf_split in R/harvest_strategies.R) keeps the page footer number from each page; no post_fn removes it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a post-processing step for steiner that removes lines matching ^\s*\d{1,3}\s*$ and rejoins the text across the page break.

findings.description: PDF layout leaks into the text: lines are hard-wrapped mid-sentence, bullets appear as mixed glyphs/indentation ('•' and blank-indented items), sentences are split by blank lines at page breaks, words are hyphen-wrapped ('FoU-\noppgave'), and facts-box labels are aligned with runs of spaces. Structure is readable but bullets/paragraphs cannot be told from wrapped lines.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Plain PDF text extraction with layout preservation (pdftools/pdf_text) without reflow.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a post_fn that joins wrapped lines within a paragraph (line not ending in punctuation followed by lowercase start), dehyphenates, normalises bullet characters to '- ', collapses runs of spaces in the facts box, and removes blank lines inside a sentence.
